tpcdi-phases:duckdb:attributes_in_later_: SELECT DISTINCT DataSet, Attribute FROM Audit WHERE BatchID > $latest_batch
tpcdi-phases:duckdb:completion_record: SELECT MAX(MessageDateAndTime) FROM DImessages WHERE MessageType = 'PCR' AND BatchID = $batch_id
tpcdi-phases:duckdb:correct_value: UPDATE Audit SET Value = $value WHERE DataSet = $data_set AND BatchID = $batch AND Attribute = $attribute
tpcdi-phases:duckdb:dvalues_not_stored: SELECT TRIM(DataSet), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(BatchID), '') AS INT), TRIM(Attribute), TRIM(DValue) FROM READ_CSV($paths, header = TRUE, "columns" = {'DataSet': 'VARCHAR', 'BatchID': 'VARCHAR', 'Date': 'VARCHAR', 'Attribute': 'VARCHAR', 'Value': 'VARCHAR', 'DValue': 'VARCHAR'}) WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(DValue), '') IS NULL AND TRY_CAST(TRIM(DValue) AS DECIMAL(15, 5)) IS NULL ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
tpcdi-phases:duckdb:load_audit: INSERT INTO Audit SELECT TRIM(DataSet), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(BatchID), '') AS INT), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(Date), '') AS DATE), TRIM(Attribute), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(Value), '') AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(DValue), '') AS DECIMAL(15, 5)) FROM READ_CSV($paths, header = TRUE, "columns" = {'DataSet': 'VARCHAR', 'BatchID': 'VARCHAR', 'Date': 'VARCHAR', 'Attribute': 'VARCHAR', 'Value': 'VARCHAR', 'DValue': 'VARCHAR'})
tpcdi-phases:duckdb:webbed_loaded: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DUCKDB_EXTENSIONS() WHERE extension_name = 'webbed' AND loaded
